name: Cork, Ireland

visa.notes: Stamp 0 visa for retirees requires ~€50K/year income. Must have private health insurance.

rent.notes: Daft Q1 2026 asking rents Cork city: 2-bed apartment EUR 2,126, 2-bed house EUR 2,206, 3-bed house EUR 2,516 (Cork county 3-bed house EUR 1,937). RTB Q3 2025 new-tenancy average Cork city EUR 1,753 (+9.6% y/y). Pet-friendly 2-3BR modelled at ~EUR 2,100.

sources.title: Daft.ie Rental Price Report Q1 2026 (via RTE)
RTB Rent Index Q3 2025

groceries.notes: CSO HBS 2022-23: two-adult households spend EUR 143.52/wk on food (incl. meals out); uplifted ~10% for food CPI since 2023 (4.5% y/y Oct 2025), ~75% taken as at-home groceries (~EUR 510/mo) plus ~EUR 90/mo food for a 100 lb dog. Buffer is 100 so basket rule does not apply.

sources.title: CSO Household Budget Survey 2022-2023 Results and Analysis
CSO Consumer Price Index October 2025
Dogs Trust Ireland - Cost of dog ownership

utilities.notes: Selectra Nov 2026: average electricity bill EUR 1,887/yr (EUR 157/mo at 4,200 kWh) and gas EUR 1,554/yr (EUR 129/mo at 11,000 kWh); no domestic water charges in Ireland; private bin collection ~EUR 20-30/mo. Numbeo Cork basic utilities for 85m2 apartment EUR 215/mo (min end). Oil-heated houses similar to gas.

sources.title: Selectra.ie - Average gas and electricity bill in Ireland
Irish Times - Bin collection charges: what is the best deal
Numbeo - Cost of Living in Cork

healthcare.notes: HIA weighted average adult premium EUR 1,902/yr at end-2025 (EUR 1,960 Q1 2026) x2 = ~EUR 330/mo; cheaper plans from ~EUR 550-1,100/yr each (min), richer plans up to EUR 4,000/yr (max). No public-system contributions for residents, but GP visits are fee-per-visit. Buy private cover within 9 months of becoming resident or a Lifetime Community Rating loading of 2%/yr over age 34 (52% at 60, for 10 years) applies.

sources.title: HIA Market Report 2025
HIA - Lifetime Community Rating
Settle.ie - Healthcare in Ireland 2026: what you will pay

insurance.notes: Re-modelled from old template (health) to renters contents cover only: AA Ireland quotes contents insurance from EUR 11.12/mo for EUR 15k cover; typical EUR 15/mo for a couple with higher contents.

sources.title: AA Ireland - Home contents insurance

petCare.notes: Dogs Trust Ireland: vaccinations EUR 100-150/yr plus flea/worm EUR 180/yr (~EUR 25/mo) for an average dog; large-breed dosing, annual check-up and occasional treatment lifts a 100 lb dog to ~EUR 65/mo. Excludes food and pet insurance.

sources.title: Dogs Trust Ireland - Cost of dog ownership

petDaycare.notes: Rover median home boarding ~EUR 35/night in Cork (range EUR 20-55); Dogs Trust daycare EUR 10-35/day. Modelled as ~4 nights/days per month on average; large dogs often carry a surcharge.

sources.title: Rover - Dog boarding in Cork
Dogs Trust Ireland - Cost of dog ownership

petGrooming.notes: Petmania (national chain with stores in Cork, Galway and Limerick) large long/heavy-coated breed 12-month plan EUR 449/yr (~EUR 37/mo, 6 full grooms + 6 washes + nail trims); standalone full grooms for a Bernese every 6-8 weeks run higher.

sources.title: Petmania - Large long/heavy-coated breed 12 month grooming plan
Dogs Trust Ireland - Cost of dog ownership

transportation.notes: One mid-size petrol car: OUTsurance 2025 guide gives fuel EUR 1,560 (15,000 km at EUR 1.76/l), insurance EUR 616, motor tax EUR 270-600, servicing/maintenance EUR 736 per year, i.e. ~EUR 270-290/mo excl. depreciation; retiree mileage ~10,000 km trims fuel. Adult Leap bus single EUR 1.70 (daily cap 5.10, weekly 20.40). Free Travel pass only from age 66.

sources.title: OUTsurance 2025 Car Running Cost Guide
Transport for Ireland - Bus fares
NTA 2026 Cork capping fare determination

entertainment.notes: Home internet: 500Mb-1Gb fibre EUR 35-40 intro, ~EUR 40-60 standard (eir/Vodafone/Virgin); streaming ~EUR 35; dining out 3x/mo at Numbeo Cork mid-range meal for two EUR 86 (~EUR 260); cinema EUR 12, gym EUR 55 -> activities ~EUR 60.

phoneCell.notes: Two SIM-only lines: 48 EUR 12.99/mo (unlimited 5G data), Clear Mobile EUR 12.99, Sky Mobile EUR 12.99 unlimited; Numbeo average mobile plan ~EUR 19-21/mo. Two lines ~EUR 26-42/mo.

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: GP visits EUR 50-70 each (no GP visit card under 70 unless low income), out-of-hours EUR 60-80, A&E EUR 100 without referral, public inpatient charges abolished 2023; add dental/optical/physio. ~6 GP visits each per year plus dental/optical ~EUR 120/mo for two. Prescription costs sit in the separate medicine category (DPS cap EUR 80/mo).

sources.title: Settle.ie - Healthcare in Ireland 2026: what you will pay

healthcare.system: HSE with Cork University Hospital (CUH) - one of Ireland's largest hospitals. Good specialist care.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Private insurance required for Stamp 0 holders

pros: Ireland's food capital with English Market and restaurant scene

pros.text: Growing tech hub: Apple's European HQ in Cork since 1980 (~6,000 employees as of 2024); also Dell EMC, Pfizer, others
